vars.goal: a title menu as the main scene res://main.tscn (root Main) with Menu/StartButton, Menu/ContinueButton, Menu/SettingsButton and Menu/QuitButton, where Start adds a rival select (a child of Main named RivalSelect, with a button Box/Grid/Rival<N>Button per rival, open once the rival before is beaten, and Box/BackButton back to the menu) and choosing a rival adds the game scene res://game/game.tscn as a child of Main named Game, with its rival in the property rival and the rival's name in its HUD/RivalLabel (rival 1 is Tallow the Novice); pause: Escape or the button HUD/PauseButton of the game shows its PauseMenu node (a CanvasLayer with ResumeButton and QuitButton) and pauses the tree, ResumeButton hides it and resumes; rivals 2 and 3 in data/rivals.json, each with its own legal deck in data/decks.json; a data.json for the kit's data runner; and a save by a SaveStore class (scripts/SaveStore.cs: new SaveStore(path) with Read() and Write(SaveData data), where SaveData has Record, a dictionary from rival ids as text to a RivalRecord with Wins and Losses, and Duel, the duel in progress as the JsonObject Duel.ToDict() gives, or null) in user://save.json, so that ContinueButton carries on that duel, restored by Duel.FromDict with both keepers' hands, decks, discard piles and rows
